findings.title: Malformed waterings response crashes the filtered list and leaves other beds' rows under the filter
findings.expected: A visible error saying the waterings could not be loaded
findings.actual: Uncaught 'waterings.value?.reduce is not a function'; the page is stuck on 'Loading waterings…' and keeps showing the unfiltered list (including Shade corner) while North bed is selected
findings.evidence: {"alerts":["Loading waterings…"],"rows":["12 Nov 2026, 17:35\tNorth bed\t–\tDelete","10 Nov 2026\tNorth bed\t0 L\tDelete","5 Nov 2026\tShade corner\t4 L\tDelete","1 Nov 2026\tNorth bed\t10 L\tDelete","1 Jan 1\tNorth bed\t1 L\tDelete"],"pageErrors":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"],"text":["Loading waterings…","Watering log","Waterings, most recent first","WHEN\tBED\tAMOUNT","ACTIONS","12 Nov 2026, 17:35\tNorth bed\t–\tDelete","watering of North bed","10 Nov 2026\tNorth bed\t0 L\tDelete"],"recovered":5} | {"alerts":["Loading waterings…"],"rows":["12 Nov 2026, 17:35\tNorth bed\t–\tDelete","10 Nov 2026\tNorth bed\t0 L\tDelete","5 Nov 2026\tShade corner\t4 L\tDelete","1 Nov 2026\tNorth bed\t10 L\tDelete","1 Jan 1\tNorth bed\t1 L\tDelete"],"pageErrors":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"],"text":["Loading waterings…","Watering log","Waterings, most recent first","WHEN\tBED\tAMOUNT","ACTIONS","12 Nov 2026, 17:35\tNorth bed\t–\tDelete","watering of North bed","10 Nov 2026\tNorth bed\t0 L\tDelete"],"recovered":5}

findings.title: Clicking the Waterings nav link while a bed filter is active keeps the old filter
findings.expected: URL /waterings shows all beds' waterings with the Bed select on 'All beds'
findings.actual: URL changes to /waterings but the Bed select stays on 'Shade corner' and only that bed's waterings are listed, so URL and page state disagree
findings.evidence: {"url":"/waterings","fields":[{"label":"Bed","value":"2"}],"rows":["5 Nov 2026\tShade corner\t4 L\tDelete"]} | {"url":"/waterings","fields":[{"label":"Bed","value":"2"}],"rows":["5 Nov 2026\tShade corner\t4 L\tDelete"]}

findings.title: A hanging waterings request leaves the page stuck loading with stale rows from other beds
findings.expected: After a while, an error and a way to retry; the old rows should not be presented as the filtered results
findings.actual: After 13 s it still says 'Loading waterings…' and lists every bed's waterings under the 'Shade corner' filter. There is no error and no timeout

findings.title: Dashboard Recent waterings shows garbage rows for a malformed response
findings.expected: An error saying recent waterings could not be loaded
findings.actual: The table shows rows reading 'Never' with an empty bed and '–' amount, and there is no error
